decision_order: score using pre-update full state; immutable alarm; WAIT/PROMOTE/DISCARD; apply any update after output
write_definition: effective persistent normality state mutation: memory/parameters/adapter/optimizer/scaler/calibration/reference admissions, with point IDs and active loss weights; selected/pending != written
formal_TTAccept: max(0,t_formal_commit-t_settled_B); report premature/invalid separately; no formal commit -> censored; native methods with no regime commit -> N/A_NATIVE
baseline_B_exposure_latency: first actual effective mutation including B cohort, separately valid clean-settled-B exposure; NOT called formal acceptance
acceptance_horizon: settled_B until first injected B anomaly, per sealed physical schedule; late results secondary
FAR_admit_primary: negative semantic/anomaly episodes having>=1 effective committed exposure / all evaluable negative episodes
false_admission_purity: unique invalid admitted point IDs / all unique admitted point IDs; denominator0 -> N/A_NO_WRITES
per_state_exposure: parameter/memory/scaler/calibration paths separately plus union; report weighted/repeated loss exposure and masks
premature: formal B commit before settled_B; timing and contaminated cohort indicators distinct
transition_FP_burden: false alarms on source-benign transition/settled-B points from transition start until first formal commit, or horizon censor; report count/rate/duration; exclude anomalies; native no-commit arm additionally align to B-effective-exposure endpoint
post_admission_anomaly_retention: unadjusted point/event recall and delay for fixed B-anomaly events after valid formal B commit; no valid commit before event -> N/A with coverage; exposure-conditioned baseline results separately; compare same events to frozen detector
old_normal_retention: read-only independent A probe FPR change pre vs after valid B commit; no side effects; no valid commit -> N/A; not recurrence
recurrence_reactivation_cost: secondary N/A in first protocol; no A-return stream generated
never_admit: FAR negative opportunity denominator may equal0 observed admissions, but purity N/A, acceptance censored and coverage0; never label safe/adaptation success
N: physical generator seed group; real source/native group; not variants/windows/seeds of detector/updates
real_TSB: admission timing, legitimate-transition FPR, old-normal semantics N/A without context; drift-mask qualification only
semantic_twin: paired identical X opposite admission semantics; unavoidable error must be reported separately; no observability/safety guarantee
